title: FREE REQUEST Looking for RPG Maker MZ Developer

posts.author: kamimichiku_
posts.body:
Hello everyone.
I’m currently developing a psychological horror project titled
Shadows of Thornhill
. The story takes place in the fog-covered village of Ashford, where an old curse lingers around the decaying Blackwood Manor, a place long abandoned but never forgotten. for
Shadows of Thornhill,
I’ve completed most of the story, detailed character sheets, location descriptions, and atmosphere design documents.
Elara arrives in Ashford seeking answers about her brother's disappearance. She teams up with Jonah, who has reluctantly returned to the manor to confront the darkness that has plagued his family for generations. Together, they unravel the manor’s history, discovering that the Blackwood family was once renowned for their esoteric knowledge and dark rituals, which ultimately led to their downfall. As they delve deeper into the manor, Elara and Jonah encounter the malevolent spirit of Matilda Blackwood, the family matriarch who dabbled in forbidden occult practices. Matilda's spirit, driven mad by her quest for eternal life, now commands a host of supernatural insects that infest the manor, manifesting her rage and despair.
My strengths are narrative writing and worldbuilding, I’ve already created the foundation for the game’s story and setting, What I need now is a
RPG Maker MZ developer
who can help with the implementation side: eventing, systems, maps, and general setup. I’ll be fully involved in scripting dialogue, writing in-game text, organizing scenes, and working closely with you on story pacing and flow, I’m fully committed to seeing this project through. My goal is to create a complete, playable demo first, something small but polished enough to show the potential of the story, If this sounds interesting to you, please reach out to me here or on Discord at
kamimichikeu_88497.
Thank you for your time!
